description: Use when the user asks for more detail about ONE specific deal already returned by another tool: setup costs, price-rise terms, what happens after the intro period and availability at their address. Pass the deal_id from the earlier result, plus the user's postcode, uprn and address_label when known so availability is confirmed at their address. total_contract_cost here is the whole-contract figure over contract_months.

address_label.description: The display_address the user picked from search_addresses, passed back verbatim. Carried into the switch link so the FindBroadband site greets the user with their address instead of asking again.

deal_id.description: The deal_id from a previous find_broadband_deals or check_if_overpaying result.

postcode.description: Pass the user's postcode when known so availability is checked at their address.

uprn.description: Property identifier from search_addresses. Pass it whenever the user has picked an address so results become address-precise instead of postcode-wide. Never show this number to the user.

name: get_deal_details

gift.description: Provider incentive shown on the deal card: a gift card / reward, or a switching credit. NOT included in any cost figure. A switching credit (e.g. 'up to £300') only offsets early-termination fees the user owes their CURRENT provider — worth £0 to someone out of contract, so explain it as conditional, never as a discount. Gift cards are real value but not bill money.

upload_mbps.description: Advertised upload. Left out for satellite (Starlink), whose feed figure is wrong: Ofcom reports Starlink averages about 20 Mbps up.

title: Get full details for one deal
